deliverables.title: Fold taxonomy + DOA register (decode-only; dead folds refused by name)
deliverables.report: Revised after George's corrections: Invariant W (weight space never wasted) makes the dense packer the placement law and waste% a reported metric; decode analog time is assignment-invariant at the floor; the frontier is SYSTEM SIZING; no safety margins. The DOA register was updated to match. Detail: docs/qif/status/P7_notes.md.

deliverables.title: Dense packer (Invariant W) + K-inner accumulator pricing + waste% metric; degenerate identity
deliverables.report: cim_timing.dense_pack streams every tensor's (K,N) blocks into consecutive BANKS with no per-tensor rounding and reports ONE waste accounting, itemized into remainder + tail, against the global cell floor; price_accumulation prices the in-macro K stack and leaves a SPREAD stack to the existing row-block law (D21). DEAD_FOLDS + refuse_dead_fold are D26's register in code, with no machinery behind any refusal. The degenerate identity is tile-for-tile on every shipped card, and where the card admits a finer bank the delta is disclosed: Granite at bank_depth 1 packs 4828 macros against 5544 dedicated, floor 2876. Assumptions and the full census: docs/qif/status/P7_notes.md.

deliverables.title: Dense packing as a mapping mode; cross-layer bank sharing; utilization as a required output
deliverables.report: mapping.packing is the config surface ('dense' is now what every shipped QIF card declares, D27), the lowered DAG carries an accumulator op per LOCAL K stack on the owning macro's pool, and a dense PREFILL is refused by name (D25/D26). Every run MEASURES the two facts rather than asserting them: each macro walks its occupied column sets exactly once per beat, and the delay one layer's residents cost another is reported per term. Per-device-class utilization and waste% are required outputs of every report and atlas export, with an unconditional banner naming the binding class (D28). The Granite dense-vs-dedicated comparison is checked in behind a byte gate at docs/qif/folding/granite_dense_vs_dedicated.json. Detail: docs/qif/status/P7_notes.md.

deliverables.title: Frontier v2 (D29-D32): stage granularity x mux depth x chip capacity vs (area, tokens/s), digital derived per point, DAG-verified
deliverables.report: The frontier is regime v2 (D29-D32): STAGE GRANULARITY buys throughput (it moves the chip split, D, the beat and the state bill at once), CHIP CAPACITY is the area axis and MUX/BANK DEPTH the third; digital provisioning is not an axis, because D31 derives the engine at every point and D32 prices it. The walk is a LADDER, never a cross product, every point it looks at is placed and priced in full, and the front is disclosed as the non-dominated set of the VISITED points. The silicon accounting carries three terms - analog slots, shared digital chiplets, per-macro pools - and is composed AFTER pricing, so the D31-derived scan engine is in it (P7.9 fixed the reverse); a last stage `state` runs D29's residency check after pricing, so a refused point still reports its throughput. Assumptions, the axis that is NOT swept, and the files outside the set: docs/qif/status/P7_notes.md.

deliverables.title: Granite + Qwen decode frontier curves with D, the state bill and per-device utilization, regenerate-gated
deliverables.report: Two curves, checked in under docs/qif/dse/ behind regenerate-and-compare gates with an --emit-config/--verify round trip; each frontier config is the SHIPPED machine plus the mapping_dse block and nothing else, and both are placed under D27's DENSE law. REGENERATED FOR ADJ-9 (D31-v2 derives the engine to the analog floor at every point). GRANITE-4.0-H-TINY: 9 of 16 visited points valid, front over 3 points, 25638.5 tokens/s at 10528.9 mm2 up to 26051.9 at 12433.0 (was 14770 -> 15299 over 10388 -> 12255), NO knee (the front is straight, and naming an endpoint would invent one); its bound is MEMORY, not silicon - stage plans finer than the front's are refused by residency against the config's own 64 MiB L2, with the stage and the bytes named. QWEN3.5-4B: 30 of 39 valid, front over 12 points (was 5), 3536.6 to 14846.5 tokens/s (4.2x) for 3645.6 -> 4793.5 mm2 (+31.5%), knee `c026` (was `c008`); the ladder now walks further because a properly sized engine changes what stage granularity buys. The analog term is the ladder's choice of capacity and never the cell floor pinning it (P7.9's correction stands), and the quantity that really moves with stage granularity is still the STATE BILL, with every point carrying its own D27 cell census. Assumptions and the axes that are deliberately not swept: docs/qif/status/P7_notes.md.

deliverables.title: Folding card + macro time-lane view + knee explorer in the atlas
deliverables.report: atlas.html gained the folding card (fws_fold/1), the macro time-lane drill-in (fws_pass/1) and the frontier explorer (fws_frontier/1), with 30 new refusals and 4 view rules in the self-test and the DOA register enforced twice. Both fixtures are grounded in real artifacts row for row, and a test pins the viewer's dead-fold register as a superset of cim_timing.DEAD_FOLDS so the two copies cannot drift. The frontier fixture now carries all three silicon terms and D27's CELL census (P7.9); its one remaining marked field is the per-candidate shared-digital occupancy, which no producer emits. Detail: docs/qif/status/P7_notes.md.

deliverables.title: Filled-pipeline regime (D29/D30): staggered streams, one token per beat, D-stream state residency
deliverables.report: The filled pipeline is the serving regime of every mapped run (D29): stages come from the stage plan, D = the stage count and is DERIVED, a batch is refused BY NAME at three seams, and the endpoints are refused by name (D30). The BEAT emerges as the measured interval between token exits - read off the settled tail so it does not move with the window (P7.9) - and tokens/s = 1/beat, per-stream = 1/(D x beat). Every stage's state and KV for all D streams rides the report with a named verdict against the ON-CHIP tier, the activation stub beside it. Contention follows D29: within-stage sharing is measured at exactly 0.0 and cross-stage sharing is its own priced term, shown positive on a machine where the macro really collides. GRANITE: D = 10, 15103 tokens/s, 57.6 MiB on the worst stage. The six regime-change rewrites and the assumptions: docs/qif/status/P7_notes.md.

deliverables.title: Library pricing + derived sizing (ADJ-9: derived to the ANALOG FLOOR)
deliverables.report: ADJ-9 (D31-v2) retargeted the derivation: the engine is sized UP until EVERY stage's digital per-stage time fits that stage's OWN measured analog m-pass rather than the analog beat, and all 10 Granite stages and all 8 Qwen stages are analog-bound by construction. GRANITE derives 5479 lanes against the old 220 for a beat of 66.21 -> 39.04 us = 15103.6 -> 25617.6 tokens/s (+69.6%) at 12983.2 -> 13132.0 mm2 (+1.15%, all of it the composed scan engine); QWEN derives 7971 against 169 for 7244 -> 14143.1 tokens/s (+95.2%) at +2.18% silicon. THE FINDING: the analog side still does not set the BEAT - the beat-setting stage spends 18.6 us on the attention systolic fabric against a 1.6 us analog m-pass, and that fabric is DECLARED card geometry D31 derives no width for - so the derived point is WIDER than the retired sweep's 4096-lane declared point and is dominated by it on the (area, tokens/s) picture. vector_lanes is now REFUSED BY NAME as a sweep axis, the Wave-D demo is frozen and labelled at docs/qif/dse/granite_lanes_banks_retired, and its D31-legal successor is granite_capacity_banks. The rewrites and the seven assumptions: docs/qif/status/P7_notes.md.

deliverables.title: Adversarial-audit fixes (F1-F3): the frontier's missing engine, the window-sensitive beat, Invariant W in force
deliverables.report: THREE REAL DEFECTS, FIXED. (1) The frontier composed its shared-digital chiplet at the MAPPING stage, before D31 installs the derived engine, so every point of both curves dropped 0.6-1.3 mm2 of scan engine per chiplet while claiming provenance composed-measured; it is now composed AFTER pricing, both curves are regenerated, and a validator row and the --verify round trip compare the sweep's area against the evaluator's own composition. (2) The beat held out exactly one fill interval and took the median of the rest, which moved the Granite headline 12% between decode_window 2 and 3 on a run that flagged itself unconverged; it is now the median of the longest SETTLED TAIL, every dropped ramp interval is printed and disclosed, and a D = 12 test prices the same machine at two window sizes and demands the same beat. (3) No shipped config declared mapping.packing: dense, so D27's law governed nothing and the frontier claimed the cell floor pinned its analog term; every QIF card now declares it, every sweep point reports its own CELL census, and the claim is corrected to what the ladder actually did. Also: per-stage residency is judged against the on-chip SRAM-L2 tier with the DRAM stub beside it under its own name; the cross-stage bank-sharing test stopped being a tautology and has a positive twin; the frontier fixture gained its third silicon term and D27's cell census; and the status entries were cut to the protocol's length with the detail moved verbatim to docs/qif/status/P7_notes.md.
questions: ANSWERED by ADJ-9 (2026-08-25): no labelled wider-than-derived point on the frontier - the derivation itself moves to the analog floor instead. What that answer bought and what it did not is in P7.8 above: every stage is analog-bound, and the machine is still bound by the attention fabric, which is a DECLARED geometry and a D28 sweep axis rather than a D31 derived engine. Whether SA geometry should join stage granularity / capacity / bank depth on the frontier is the question that replaces it, and it is George's.
